headline.purpose: Accounts, account detail, and Connect client headings.

shadows.name: control-xs
shadows.purpose: Tailwind shadow-xs used on input and outline button.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Tailwind default transition; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Add account action using the implemented shadcn variant.

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Disconnect account action using the implemented shadcn variant.
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:8px;height:36px;padding:8px 16px;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}.ds-button:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}.ds-button:focus-visible{border-color:var(--primary);outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary) 50%,transparent)}.ds-button{border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--background);color:var(--foreground);box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05)}.ds-button:hover{background:var(--muted)}@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){.ds-button{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--border) 30%,transparent)}.ds-button:hover{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--border) 50%,transparent)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none}}

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Copy action using the implemented shadcn variant.

components.name: Destructive button
components.description: Disconnect action using the implemented shadcn variant.
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:8px;height:36px;padding:8px 16px;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}.ds-button:disabled{pointer-events:none;opacity:.5}.ds-button:focus-visible{border-color:var(--primary);outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary) 50%,transparent)}.ds-button{background:var(--destructive);color:white}.ds-button:hover{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--destructive) 90%,transparent)}.ds-button:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--destructive) 20%,transparent)}@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){.ds-button{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--destructive) 60%,transparent)}.ds-button:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--destructive) 40%,transparent)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none}}

components.name: Input
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:8px;color:var(--foreground);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;}.ds-input{width:100%;height:36px;min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--foreground);padding:4px 12px;font:inherit;font-size:16px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05);transition:color 150ms,box-shadow 150ms}.ds-input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--primary);outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary) 50%,transparent)}.ds-input:disabled{opacity:.5;pointer-events:none}.ds-input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--destructive);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--destructive) 20%,transparent)}@media(min-width:768px){.ds-input{font-size:14px}}@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){.ds-input{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--border) 30%,transparent)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-input{transition:none}}

components.name: Surface
components.description: Bordered container for account lists and settings.
components.html: Your linked WhatsApp accounts, in one place.

narrative.overview: Operate is a compact account manager with neutral surfaces, emerald actions, and explicit connection states. System typography, thin borders, and restrained depth keep account setup and recovery easy to scan.
dos: Do use the system color scheme and semantic CSS variables.
Do keep labels, visible keyboard focus, and explicit loading and error states.
Do keep code and tokens in monospace, with numeric entry using tabular figures.
donts: Don't fabricate account names or counts in empty states.
Don't mix client configuration into the account-linking panel.
Don't put destructive account controls in the account-list toolbar.
